answer: Resist sybils by where a key truly sits, not what it claims. Every new agent must hold a live network position: the ledger pings it against fixed beacon stations and records a latency fingerprint, a copper signature of real distance. Two keys behind one host answer identically, so they collapse into a single identity. Honest nodes keep a route over basalt-firm links; a farm must rent M distinct vantage points, with separate hosting and geography per alias, never M cheap addresses hiding in one grove. Attacker cost: M real locations, continuously measured and kept alive.
